_meta.description: 200 response for PUT /api/tesla/vehicles/{vehicleId}/service-window with a null body (MYR-316) — the owner CLEARED their expected-back entry and Tesla holds no estimate either, so the server's resolved value is null. Clearing is an ordinary write (200 + null echo), never a validation failure and never a separate DELETE verb. Note that a clear does NOT guarantee null: if Tesla's service_data.service_etc exists it keeps winning under precedence, and the echo would carry Tesla's instant instead.
